text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Canary wave-3 (us-east-1) -> elevated 5xx on /v1/generate and failing health checks. 5m error rate = 7% (abort threshold = 2%). Auto-paging @alice :rotating_light:
alice: Ack. Oncall here — looking at canary logs and healthcheck graphs now. Tagging @bob for infra help.
bob: Looking into node telemetry. I'm seeing repeated container restarts on quantized-gpu-2 pools, oom_score > 0.8 on several pods. Pulling kube events.
charlie: I noticed a recent injector change that alters KV cache prefetch window (PR #4821). Could be causing a cache miss storm and memory blowup. Will grep for recent rollouts.
diana: Customer-impact update: CS dashboard shows ~8 API keys with >30% 502s in the last 10m. Escalating to priority.
alice: Initiating emergency stop for the canary. Flipping kill-switch flag: rollout.canary.enabled -> false. Command: ``/ops/flags set rollout.canary.enabled false --actor=alice`` :warning:
incident-bot: Flag action recorded and policy triggered: fallback to baseline model and abort canary routing. Rolling traffic back per rollback-policy v2.
bob: Starting automated rollback. kubectl rollout undo deployment/canary-wave-3 --to-revision=12
console: rollout started (eta ~ 2m).
emily: Notifying CS and affected customers that mitigation is in progress. Drafting note for impacted API keys.
charlie: After the flag flip and rollback start I'm still seeing a brief spike in connection resets but healthchecks already trending down. Investigating whether the injector change caused KV cache thrashing.
alice: Can folks confirm latency and 5xx trend?
bob: Metrics: 5xx dropped from 7% -> 1.2% within 90s of rollback start. Error budget back within threshold at t+3m.
charlie: Heap profiles show many short-lived allocations in tokenizer path when batch size spiked. Might be an accidental default change to batch_window_ms in the rollout config. Opening PR to revert.
diana: CS will send proactive update to the 8 affected customers now that rollback is underway. No broad outage declared.
alice: Closing on-call pager for now. Assigning follow-up: @charlie to lead RCA (label: canary-wave3-502). @bob to verify autoscaler and memory limits for quantized pools. @diana to coordinate customer outreach.
emily: Thanks — I'll update the incident record and attach log snippets.
charlie: Quick log excerpt:
```
2026-03-17T14:05:23Z canary-pod-42 stderr: kv_cache.go:219 WARN cache miss surge: prefetch_window=500ms -> increase alloc
2026-03-17T14:05:24Z canary-pod-42 stdout: OOMKilled
```
charlie: Proposed next steps: revert injector change, tighten K8s memory requests for quantized nodes, add a hard abort threshold for cache miss rate to the canary gate.
alice: Sounds good. I'll post a short handoff in #postmortems and schedule a 30m triage in 1h. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
